goal: Double-booking under true concurrency (ROADMAP D1, Spec03 DB-01..03). N users are held at a gate and released at the same instant on the same slot. The expected output is a COUNT across all users, not one response: exactly as many 201 as there is capacity, every other user 409. Afterwards verify/invariants.sql must return 0 rows.
precondition: Profile 'race', standalone (no workers), users = 10. Day = 'run' → each run lands on a fresh day 30–329 days ahead; reseed (seeding/seed.sh) if a run is repeated with the same day.
_doc: Input requests. Locust loads this file, binds {{tokens}}, sends each request, then checks it against expectedFile.

cases.goal: Capacity 1: London Park Royal has ONE oil-change technician (Yuki). 10 different cars want 10:00 London time → exactly 1 x 201, 9 x 409. Two 201s = the exclusion constraint or the retry loop is broken.

Idempotency race: the SAME request with the SAME Idempotency-Key from 10 users at once (a client retrying in parallel) → 10 x 201 and ONE appointment id. A unique-key violation must be turned into 'return the existing one', not 409/500.

One car, many keys: the same vehicle booked 10 times at once with DIFFERENT keys at the hub, which has 6 free oil-change technicians and 8 bays → still exactly 1 x 201, the rest 422 (Spec07 D2): the vehicle itself is a resource (DB-03).
